title: Kyler Murray leaves Vikings debut after scary hit to the helmet, bad interception on first pass vs. Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyler Murray leaves Vikings debut after scary hit to the helmet, bad interception on first pass vs. Packers
sources.description: Kyler Murray's first pass as the Vikings' starter was a tough throw into double coverage that Keisean Nixon easily intercepted.
